caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, woven pattern centrally placed on a plain, off-white background. The woven pattern uses three main colors: a muted red, dark blue, and beige. The design is bordered by a rectangular frame that alternates between beige with red and blue accents. Inside the border, each corner features a checkered square pattern formed from blue and beige, while the center of each side panel contains a rectangular section of beige with evenly spaced red and blue weaves. The inner portion of the rectangle is dominated by a larger square made of a tighter red weave, intersected by blue lines forming a secondary checkered pattern. The overall composition exhibits symmetry with the colored squares and rectangles arranged evenly. There is a small, handwritten signature or notation in black ink near the lower right of the woven pattern, set against the otherwise blank background.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
